coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/navigation.ts:59 says an entry without an action key shows for everyone. useNavigation.ts:78-80 takes the entry action (or the route meta action) and shows the entry only when access.can(needed) is true or no key is set. Page: 'A page that needs no permission shows to everyone.'

server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:406 has MFloor("dashboard:read", Mod, Vip). navigation.ts:81 gives Home action dashboard:read. Page: 'A moderator and up opens Home'.

dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/ShieldToggle.vue:33-42: when the screen is not narrow it calls setShield.mutate at once, otherwise it opens the ConfirmDialog. useLayout.ts:21-22 and 43-45 define narrow as smaller than tablet (768). The dialog title frame.shield.confirmOn/confirmOff names {channel} (i18n/locales/en.json, frame.shield), and its buttons are Turn on/Turn off and common.cancel (ConfirmDialog.vue:97).

ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:269-270 sets moderation:shieldmode:read to Mod and moderation:shieldmode:write to LeadModerator. ModerationController.cs:837-838 and 856-857 put RequireAction on the GET and PATCH shield routes.

dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/ProfileMenu.vue:89 sets isOwner only when not previewing and current.kind is 'own'. Lines 154-161 show View as moderator and View as viewer only when isOwner. ViewAsBanner.vue:24-36 shows 'Viewing as {role}' with Exit.

reader_answers.evidence: The role filter matches useNavigation.ts:115-131 and the groups match navigation.ts:73-294. The Shield state label is ShieldToggle.vue:64-66. Dismiss and Open per item are ErrorInbox.vue (file lines 93-120).

FrameActions.vue:25 gates both tools on moderation:chat:settings:read, which is Mod (seeder:267). Shield write is LeadModerator (seeder:270). roles:manage is Broadcaster (seeder:213). The Permissions tabs Team and Per person are in settings/permissions/i18n/en.json:30-32.

Shield on/off with ShieldCheck is ShieldToggle.vue:61-66. useSetShieldMode in api/shield.ts has no onError and no global mutation handler exists, so a refusal shows no message, and the label stays bound to shield.data. Badge count and the 'Nothing needs your attention.' text are ErrorInbox.vue (file lines 69, 76) and en.json frame.inbox.empty.

The rail is NavRail at 600-839 (DashboardLayout.vue, wide=sidebar 840 and medium=rail 600). The frame header holds ChannelSwitch compact when not wide. switchLocation in router/channelRoutes.ts:85-102 keeps the same page. The narrow confirm is below 768 (ShieldToggle.vue:33-42). The write still needs LeadModerator. The button is hidden while the new channel's query has no data (ShieldToggle.vue:53).
